observations: P1_U8 footprint serialized text is identical before and after feature addition.
Removing all fiducials leaves 9 missing-courtyard warnings and no mask bridge errors.
Explicit 2 mm mask-only apertures plus 1 mm copper fiducial pads leave 15 missing-courtyard warnings and no mask bridge errors.
inference: DRC appears sensitive to large local mask-margin representation; this is not yet proven as a KiCad defect.
next: Compare exported copper and mask geometry between original and explicit-aperture candidate before adoption.
